targets.rawSql: SELECT minute AS t, sum(bytes)*8/60/1e9 AS gbps FROM pipecore.flows_1m WHERE minute > now()-INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SELECT application, sum(bytes)/1e9 AS gb FROM pipecore.flows_1m WHERE minute > now()-INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY application ORDER BY gb DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT protocol, sum(bytes)/1e9 AS gb FROM pipecore.flows_1m WHERE minute > now()-INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY protocol ORDER BY gb DESC
SELECT subscriber_ref, pipe_id, sum(bytes_down+bytes_up)/1e9 AS gb, count() AS flows FROM pipecore.flows WHERE ts > now()-INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY subscriber_ref, pipe_id ORDER BY gb DESC LIMIT 50
